text.body:
॥ śivamātṛkāvarṇamālāstotram ॥
śrīsūta uvācaḥ athātassampravakṣyāmi śivasthānaṃ samāsataḥ । yatra sañcintya deveśaṃ kaivalyaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥ 1 purā nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān kirīṭī garuḍadhvajaḥ । śrīmatkailāsaparyante tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥ 2 bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅga stripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakaḥ । rudrākṣamālābharaṇo jaṭāvalkalamaṇḍitaḥ ॥ 3 tapasā taptadehasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ । prādurāsīnmahādevaśśaṅkaraḥ karuṇākaraḥ ॥ 4 taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣo mahādevaṃ ghṛṇānidhim । ambikāsahitaṃ rudraṃ candramauliṃ sanātanam ॥ 5 praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā paramayā saha । stotumārabhate viṣṇu ssarvabhūtahitāvaham ॥ 6 akārāya namassākṣādanantānantamūrtaye ॥ ātmabhūtāya sarveṣāṃ matiśuddhāya śūline ॥ 7 ākārāyātiśuddhāya sākṣiṇe sarvavastunaḥ । ambikāpataye tubhyamasaṅgāya namonamaḥ ॥ 8 ikārāyeśvarākhyāya sarvasiddhikarāya ca । indrādilokapālānā miyattākāriṇe namaḥ ॥ 9 īkārāya variṣṭhāya vānchitārthapradāya ca । vañcakānāmalabhyāya vasudāya namonamaḥ ॥ 10 ukārāyograjantūnāmugrarūpāya śūline । uttamānāṃ tu jantūnāmupāsyāya namonamaḥ ॥ 11 ūkārāyopavītāya hyūrjitāyottamātmane । uttama jñānagamyāya namaste paramātmane ॥ 12 ṛkārāyādibhūtāyaḥ rāmapūrvārcitāyaca । ṛcāmarthasvarūpāya namassatyaparātmane ॥ 13 ṝkārāya nisargāya nityatṛptāya śambhave । rasādibhūtarūpāya namaśśuddhacidātmane ॥ 14 lṛkārāya lasaddaṇḍamaṇḍitābharaṇāya ca । liṅgaliṅgyādihīnāya liṅgarūpāya te namaḥ ॥ 15 lṛkārāya layasthāya dhvaṃsakāyādihetave । lakṣāruṇaśarīrāya lābhasthānāya vai namaḥ ॥ 16 ekārāya namaśśaśva didantāsākṣiṇe tathā । ahantāsākṣiṇe sākṣātpratyagadvayavastune ॥ 17 aikārāyāmalajñānaprabhāvāpariśīlinām । ātmarūpatayā nityaṃ pratītāya namo namaḥ ॥ 18 oṅkārāya viriñcāya viṣṇave rudramūrtaye । vācyavācakahīnāya svayaṃ bhāsāya te namaḥ ॥ 19 aukārāya maheśāya mahāmantrārtharūpiṇe । mahādevāya mātrādi prapañcāya namonamaḥ ॥ 20 bindurūpāya bījāya bījādhiṣṭhānarūpiṇe । bījanāśakarajñāna svarūpāya namonamaḥ ॥ 21 visarjanīya rūpāya vismayāya mahātmane । visarjanīyaniṣṭhānāṃ viśeṣārthāya vai namaḥ ॥ 22 kakārāya kapūrvādi devatāpūjitāyaca । kāraṇagrāmasaṃharttre kālātītāya vai namaḥ ॥ 23 khakārāya khapūrvādi bhūtapañcakahetave । khamūrtāya khalaprajñā gocarāya namonamaḥ ॥ 24 gakārāya gaṇeśāya gaṇabṛndārcitāyaca । gaṅgādharāya guhyāya guṇātītāya te namaḥ ॥ 25 ghakārāya ghanākāra ghātakāya ghanātmane । ghaṭādi jagadākāra rahitāya namonamaḥ ॥ 26 ṅkārāya ṅmantrārtha svarūpāya śivātmane । ṅā ṅī ṅū saṃjñitārthānā magamyāya namonamaḥ ॥ 27 cakārāyaca mantrārtha svarūpāyāmitātmane । camantrārthaniṣaṇṇānāmamṛtāya namonamaḥ ॥ 28 chakārāya chalālasya chādanādiviśeṣataḥ । chādanacchandanacchanna vibhāgāya namonamaḥ ॥ 29 jakārāya jagacchakti svarūpāya jayārthinām । jayapradāya devāya jambhamohāya te namaḥ ॥ 30 jhakārāya jhamantrārtha svarūpāyāmṛtātmane । jhamadhya candrabimbāya namassāmbāya śambhave ॥ 31 ñakārāya ñamantrārtha svarūpāya ñamūrtaye । jñaptimātraikaniṣṭhānāṃ muktidāya namonamaḥ ॥ 32 ṭakārāya ṭa ṭā ṭī ṭū pūrvoktaistu mahāravaiḥ । arcitāya suraśreṣṭhai rasuraiścaḥ namonamaḥ ॥ 33 ṭhakārāya ṭhamantrārtha svarūpāya khamantrataḥ । ṭhaṭhādigaṇapūjyāya ṭhamadhyāya namonamaḥ ॥ 34 ḍakārāya ḍa ḍā ḍī ḍū ḍe ḍo ḍaiśca mahāravaiḥ । ḍāmarai rabhipūjyāya namonṛttapriyāyaca ॥ 35 ḍhakārāya ḍhamantrārtha parijñānavatāṃ nṛṇām । ḍhasaṃjñita mahānandapradāya satataṃ namaḥ ॥ 36 ṇakārāya ṇa ṇā ṇī ṇū ṇe ṇai ṇo ṇau ravaissadā । ṇākinī gaṇapūjyāya ṇasaṃjñāya namonamaḥ ॥ 37 takārāya taśabdārtha svarūpāya tatāyaca । tattvamityabhipūjyāya tatvabhūtāyavai namaḥ ॥ 38 thakārāya thamantrārtha svarūpāyādha saṃjñitaiḥ ।mahāgaṇaiśca pūjyāya thamadhyāya namonamaḥ ॥ 39 dakārāya dayārūpa mahāśaktimayāya ca । deśajāti vihīnāya divārātrāyavai namaḥ ॥ 40 dhakārāya dharaṇyādi mahābhūtasvarūpiṇe । dharādharahṛdisthāya dhamadhyāya namonamaḥ ॥ 41 nakārāya nagendrāya nāmajātyādihetave । namaśiśavāya namyāya nānārūpāya śūline ॥ 42 pakārāya parānandasvarūpāya parātmane । parāparavihīnāya pāvanāya namonamaḥ ॥ 43 phakārāya phalākhyāya phalākhyagaṇāya namaḥ । phaḍākhyagaṇapūjyāya namaḥ pūrṇasvarūpiṇe ॥ 44 bakārāya bakārākhya mahābījaikajāpinām । bandhanākāranāśaikahetave vedhase namaḥ ॥ 45 bhakārāya bhavābdhestu tārakāya bhavāyate । bhavaśabdaikavedyāya bhavānīpataye namaḥ ॥ 46 makārāya mahāmāyā pāśanāśaikahetave । mamakāravihīnānāṃ mahānandāya vai namaḥ ॥ 47 yakārāya yathārthāya yathārthajñānināṃ nṛṇām । yathārtha pratyagadvaitabrahmaṇe satataṃ namaḥ ॥ 48 rakārāya ratiprīti priyāya ratihetave । raśabdavapuṣe rogabhavanāśāyavai namaḥ । 49 lakārāya latāsoma svarūpāya latātmane । lābhālābhavihīnāya labdhirūpāyave namaḥ ॥ 50 vakārāya variṣṭhāya vāsudevādihetave । vāñchāvāguruvicchittihetubhūtāya vai namaḥ ॥ 51 śakārāya śaraṇyāya śambhave śaraṇārthinām । śaraṇyāya śaraccandradhavalāya namonamaḥ ॥ 52 ṣakārāya ṣaḍādhāra ṣaṭcakrādisvarūpiṇe । ṣaḍakṣara niṣaṇṇāya namaṣṣaṇmukhahetave ॥ 53 sakārāya saśabdārtha kharūpāya sadātmane । sākṣiṇe sākṣyarūpāṇāṃ namassādhūpakāriṇe ॥ 54 hakārāyāhamarthāya sadāhaṅkārarūpiṇe । hāhāhūhū pragītāya haṃsarūpāya te namaḥ ॥ 55 lakārāya lakārākhya mahāmantrapriyāyaca । ḍolācañcalasaṃsāra nāśanāya namo namaḥ ॥ 56 kṣakārāya kṣamantrārthasvarūpāya kṣamāvatām । kṣemadāya mama kṣema svarūpāya namo namaḥ ॥ 57 mātṛkāvapuṣe mātṛmānameyādisākṣiṇe mātṛkāmantralabhyāya mahaseca namo namaḥ ॥ 58 mātṛkādhārabhūtāya mātṛkāmūlarūpiṇe । mahāmantraikavācyāya mahase brahmaṇe namaḥ ॥ 59 dvidhābhūta mahāmantra svaravyañjanavyaṅgyataḥ । vācyāyāpadarūpāya padāya mahase namaḥ ॥ 60 aṣṭadhācāṣṭavargaistu vibhaktāyāmalātmane । aśeṣaśabdabhūtāya tattadarthāya vai namaḥ ॥ 61 śabdānvayavihīnāya śabdalakṣyāya sākṣiṇe । sarvopādhivihīnāya svayambhānāya vai namaḥ ॥ 62 pratyakṣādipramāṇānāmagamyāya parokṣataḥ । pratītāya svayaṃ sarvasākṣiṇe mahase namaḥ ॥ 63 svasvarūpādahīnāya vastuto vastutopi ca । arthāya mahate sākṣātsvayambhānāya vai namaḥ ॥ 64 prasādalabhyāya śivāya satyacinmahāsukhāya paravarjitāya । atīva śuddhasya hṛdambujālaye vibhāsamānāya namo namaste ॥ 65 śrīsūta uvācaḥ evaṃ nārāyaṇenaiva śaṅkarobhiṣṭutaḥ punaḥ । prāha gambhīrayā vācā kimarthaṃ taptavāṃstapaḥ ॥ 66 ityākarṇya mahāviṣṇuḥ praṇamya parameśvarama । tava sthānāni me deva brūhi sākṣātkṛpākara ॥ 67 ityukto viṣṇunā śambhussarvajñaḥ karuṇākaraḥ । prāha sarvāmareśānassthānāni svasya viṣṇave ॥ 68 yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya stotrametanmanoharam । ihāmutra phalaṃ tasya karasthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥ 69 iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe viṣṇukṛtaśivamātṛkāvarṇamālāstotram ॥
